note: Shared-rule candidates from dimension_session.logic.json. object_keys_unchanged (hashgraph_events.shared.json) covers the three shape_keys_unchanged asserts; active_dimension_path and max_turn_rule (sync_protocol.shared.json) cover descriptor_path / door_path / merged_turn. Listed here: what is specific to the session shapes.

entries.name: Validation — a shape object keeps the named keys
entries.description: subset_of(required, keys(shape)). Used by session_dimension_descriptor (identity_keys_present, tileset_keys_kept, turn_keeps_max_seen), session_door (head_and_members_present, member_item_keys_kept), session_local_state (character_has_four_stats, cards_keep_hand_and_commitment, region_peers_tiers_kept), and the *_present asserts in sync_protocol / hashgraph_events. `required` is a literal array of strings.

entries.name: Door — last push predates the current interval
entries.description: doc.last_push.interval_index < interval_index. Used by session_door.is_stale and sync_join_flow.new_location_needs_stale_door.

entries.name: Door status pattern
entries.description: Regex source for session_door.status: active | stale | merged_into:<DoorId> | closed.

entries.name: DoorId is a magnet URI with the urn:dim topic
entries.description: matches(s, '^magnet:\\?xt=urn:dim:'). Used by session_door.door_identity_present and sync_join_flow.door_id_is_magnet.
